From the expressive architecture outside to the authentic signature services inside, JW Marriott Hanoi Hotel welcomes you to experience the new definition of contemporary luxury, the perfect place for both business and leisure. This hotel offers one of the largest and most innovative meeting venues in the region including 2 ballrooms and extensive foyer areas. Adding to the luxurious accommodation with excellent facilities and professional services, the hotel has a total 450 appointed guestrooms. Our spacious 5-star hotel includes several restaurants, creating international and local cuisine. Arrive at JW Marriott Hotel Hanoi, you will be welcomed by the friendly associates, who will give you the JW Marriott complimented with the authenticity that is unique and memorable.
